semantic_nodes.name: asset name

semantic_nodes.name: asset type

semantic_nodes.affordance: Used to select suitable submodels and DT behavior.

semantic_nodes.name: manufacturer
semantic_nodes.conceptual_definition: Organization that manufactured or supplied the asset.
semantic_nodes.affordance: Used for Digital Nameplate registration and traceability.

semantic_nodes.name: model name
semantic_nodes.affordance: Used for Digital Nameplate registration and catalog matching.

semantic_nodes.name: rated voltage
semantic_nodes.conceptual_definition: Nominal voltage required for operating the asset.

semantic_nodes.name: rated current
semantic_nodes.conceptual_definition: Nominal electrical current required by the asset.
semantic_nodes.affordance: Used to determine electrical load requirements.

semantic_nodes.name: serial number
semantic_nodes.conceptual_definition: Unique serial identifier assigned by the manufacturer.

semantic_nodes.name: weight
semantic_nodes.conceptual_definition: Mass or weight of the asset.
semantic_nodes.affordance: Used for installation, transport, and simulation metadata.
